notes.title: New Milks and some information about incoming updates
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We know it's been a while since our last update, and we appreciate your patience and continued support. The reason for this quiet period is that we've been hard at work on something BIG — a major update that we believe will bring a whole new level of excitement to the game!

Stay tuned for more details and sneak peeks on our Discord server in the coming days.
